description: This file contains functions and definitions for handling Git protocol packets, including packet formatting, writing, flushing, reading, and sideband demultiplexing. It implements mechanisms for packet construction, transmission, reception, and tracing, used for communication and data exchange in Git operations.

methods.name: void packet_trace_identity(const char * prog)
methods.description: Sets the trace prefix for packet tracing to a duplicate of the given program name.

methods.name: const char * get_trace_prefix(void)
methods.description: Returns the current trace prefix, considering if the code is in an asynchronous context.

methods.name: int packet_trace_pack(const char * buf,unsigned int len,int sideband)
methods.description: Handles tracing of pack data or sideband data based on input buffer and sideband flag.

methods.name: void packet_trace(const char * buf,unsigned int len,int write)
methods.description: Tracks and outputs a trace of a packet's content, with handling for pack data and sideband demultiplexing.

methods.name: void packet_flush(int fd)
methods.description: Logs and writes a flush packet to the file descriptor.

methods.name: void packet_delim(int fd)
methods.description: Logs and writes a delimiter packet.

methods.name: void packet_response_end(int fd)
methods.description: Logs and writes a response-end packet.

methods.name: int packet_flush_gently(int fd)
methods.description: Attempts to flush a flush packet gently, returning success or failure status.

methods.name: void packet_buf_flush(struct strbuf * buf)
methods.description: Adds a flush packet to the given string buffer.

methods.name: void packet_buf_delim(struct strbuf * buf)
methods.description: Adds a delimiter packet to the given string buffer.

methods.name: void set_packet_header(char * buf,int size)
methods.description: Initializes a packet header with the size encoded as hex characters.

methods.name: void format_packet(struct strbuf * out,const char * prefix,const char * fmt,va_list args)
methods.description: Formats a packet with a prefix and user format, including length encoding and tracing.

methods.name: int packet_write_fmt_1(int fd,int gently,const char * prefix,const char * fmt,va_list args)
methods.description: Writes a formatted packet to a file descriptor, optionally in a gentle mode.

methods.name: void packet_write_fmt(int fd,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Convenience wrapper for formatted packet writing.

methods.name: int packet_write_fmt_gently(int fd,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Writes a formatted packet in a gentle mode, handling errors.

methods.name: int do_packet_write(const int fd_out,const char * buf,size_t size,struct strbuf * err)
methods.description: Performs the low-level write of packet header and data to a file descriptor.

methods.name: int packet_write_gently(const int fd_out,const char * buf,size_t size)
methods.description: Attempts to write a packet gently, returning success or failure.

methods.name: void packet_write(int fd_out,const char * buf,size_t size)
methods.description: Writes a packet or terminates on failure.

methods.name: void packet_fwrite(FILE * f,const char * buf,size_t size)
methods.description: Writes data as a packet to a FILE stream.

methods.name: void packet_fwrite_fmt(FILE * fh,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Formats and writes a packet to a FILE stream.

methods.name: void packet_fflush(FILE * f)
methods.description: Flushes a packet to a FILE stream.

methods.name: void packet_buf_write(struct strbuf * buf,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Builds a packet into a string buffer.

methods.name: int write_packetized_from_fd_no_flush(int fd_in,int fd_out)
methods.description: Reads data from one file descriptor and writes packetized data to another, without flushing.

methods.name: int write_packetized_from_buf_no_flush_count(const char * src_in,size_t len,int fd_out,int * packet_counter)
methods.description: Writes data from a buffer to a file descriptor in packet form, with optional packet counting.

methods.name: int get_packet_data(int fd,char ** src_buf,size_t * src_size,void * dst,size_t size,int options)
methods.description: Reads packet data from a file descriptor, supporting error handling and partial reads.

methods.name: int packet_length(const char lenbuf_hex[4],size_t size)
methods.description: Calculates the length of a packet from its hex prefix.

methods.name: char * find_packfile_uri_path(const char * buffer)
methods.description: Extracts the path component from a packfile URI within a packet.

methods.name: enum:packet_read_status packet_read_with_status(int fd,char ** src_buffer,size_t * src_len,char * buffer,unsigned size,int * pktlen,int options)
methods.description: Reads a packet from a file descriptor, returning status and handling protocol specifics.

methods.name: int packet_read(int fd,char * buffer,unsigned size,int options)
methods.description: Reads a packet, returning its length.

methods.name: char * packet_read_line(int fd,int * dst_len)
methods.description: Reads a line from a packet stream, excluding the trailing newline.

methods.name: int packet_read_line_gently(int fd,int * dst_len,char ** dst_line)
methods.description: Reads a line from a packet stream, in a gentle mode that can handle EOF.

methods.name: ssize_t read_packetized_to_strbuf(int fd_in,struct strbuf * sb_out,int options)
methods.description: Reads packetized data into a string buffer from a file descriptor.

methods.name: int recv_sideband(const char * me,int in_stream,int out)
methods.description: Receives sideband data from a stream, handling demultiplexing and writing to output.

methods.name: void packet_reader_init(struct packet_reader * reader,int fd,char * src_buffer,size_t src_len,int options)
methods.description: Initializes a packet_reader structure for reading packets.

methods.name: enum:packet_read_status packet_reader_read(struct packet_reader * reader)
methods.description: Reads the next packet from the stream, handling sidebands and progress packets.

methods.name: enum:packet_read_status packet_reader_peek(struct packet_reader * reader)
methods.description: Peeks at the next packet, allowing lookahead.

methods.name: void packet_writer_init(struct packet_writer * writer,int dest_fd)
methods.description: Initializes a packet_writer for writing packets.

methods.name: void packet_writer_write(struct packet_writer * writer,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Writes a formatted packet using the packet_writer.

methods.name: void packet_writer_error(struct packet_writer * writer,const char * fmt,...)
methods.description: Writes an error packet using the packet_writer.

methods.name: void packet_writer_delim(struct packet_writer * writer)
methods.description: Writes a delimiter packet using the packet_writer.

methods.name: void packet_writer_flush(struct packet_writer * writer)
methods.description: Flushes pending packets through the packet_writer.
